**Windows:** download **3DS-Setup-Windows.bat** below and double-click it.

**Mac / Linux:** open Terminal and paste:

```
curl -fsSL https://github.com/erickfm/3ds-setup/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh
```

**Steam Deck:** in Desktop Mode, download **3DS-Setup-SteamDeck.desktop** below and double-click it (or type the line above in Konsole). No questions; 3DS shows up in your Steam library for Gaming Mode.

Setup ends by opening **3DS**: your game library, with Play, Add games and Older saves.

See the [README](https://github.com/erickfm/3ds-setup#readme) for details.
